blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—As the nation observes World Teachers’ Day 2026 on Monday, an education reform group called on the government to address teachers’ concerns over salaries, workloads, staffing, benefits and the full implementation of the Magna Carta for Public School Teachers. “Quality education begins with teachers who are respected, protected, adequately compensated, supported, and empowered,” said the Civil Society Network for Education Reforms (E-Net Philippines) in a statement on Sunday. E-Net Philippines noted that teacher organizations and advocates have pushed for various salary increases, including a P15,000 across-the-board increase and an entry-level salary of about P50,000.
